Name: Kaushal Aggarwal
Bio:
Kaushal Aggarwal is a Founder of Plaksha University. Kaushal is the Co-founder of Avendus and oversees the firm's credit solutions and wealth management businesses. With over 20 years of global experience in financial services, he has played a key role in shaping Avendus into a leading financial institution.

Kaushal was instrumental in creating the investment banking business at Avendus, leveraging his expertise in financial strategy, capital markets and advisory services. Before co-founding Avendus, he worked with Kotak Mahindra Bank's investment banking practice, where he gained deep insights into deal structuring and corporate finance.

His leadership has been pivotal in driving Avendus' expansion and strengthening its position in the financial services industry.
Education: MBA, IIM Bengaluru | BE, Electrical Engineering, IIT Delhi
